<?php
// secure_auction.php - Encrypted sealed-bid auction API
require_once 'vendor/autoload.php';

use Defuse\Crypto\Crypto;
use Defuse\Crypto\Key;

class AuctionServer {
    private $storageDir;
    private $encKey;
    private $lockDir;

    public function __construct(string $storageDir, Key $encKey) {
        $this->storageDir = rtrim($storageDir, '/');
        $this->lockDir = $this->storageDir . '/.locks';
        $this->encKey = $encKey;
        if (!is_dir($this->lockDir)) {
            mkdir($this->lockDir, 0700, true);
        }
    }

    private function getAuctionPath(string $auctionId): string {
        $safe = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $auctionId);
        return $this->storageDir . '/' . $safe . '.enc';
    }

    private function acquireLock(string $auctionId): mixed {
        $lockFile = $this->lockDir . '/' . preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $auctionId) . '.lock';
        $fp = fopen($lockFile, 'c');
        if ($fp === false) return false;
        if (!flock($fp, LOCK_EX)) {
            fclose($fp);
            return false;
        }
        return $fp;
    }

    private function releaseLock($fp): void {
        if ($fp) {
            flock($fp, LOCK_UN);
            fclose($fp);
        }
    }

    private function loadAuction(string $auctionId): ?array {
        $path = $this->getAuctionPath($auctionId);
        if (!file_exists($path)) return null;
        $ciphertext = file_get_contents($path);
        $json = Crypto::decrypt($ciphertext, $this->encKey);
        return json_decode($json, true);
    }

    private function saveAuction(string $auctionId, array $data): void {
        $path = $this->getAuctionPath($auctionId);
        $json = json_encode($data);
        $ciphertext = Crypto::encrypt($json, $this->encKey);
        file_put_contents($path, $ciphertext);
    }

    public function createAuction(string $auctionId, string $item, int $deadline): array {
        $lock = $this->acquireLock($auctionId);
        try {
            if ($this->loadAuction($auctionId) !== null) {
                return ['error' => 'Auction already exists'];
            }
            $auction = [
                'id' => $auctionId,
                'item' => $item,
                'deadline' => $deadline,
                'bids' => [],
                'revealed' => false,
                'created_at' => time()
            ];
            $this->saveAuction($auctionId, $auction);
            return ['success' => true, 'auction_id' => $auctionId];
        } finally {
            $this->releaseLock($lock);
        }
    }

    public function submitBid(string $auctionId, string $bidderId, string $commitHash): array {
        $lock = $this->acquireLock($auctionId);
        try {
            $auction = $this->loadAuction($auctionId);
            if ($auction === null) {
                return ['error' => 'Auction not found'];
            }
            if (time() > $auction['deadline']) {
                return ['error' => 'Bidding period closed'];
            }
            if ($auction['revealed']) {
                return ['error' => 'Auction already revealed'];
            }
            $auction['bids'][$bidderId] = [
                'commit' => $commitHash,
                'timestamp' => time()
            ];
            $this->saveAuction($auctionId, $auction);
            return ['success' => true, 'bid_count' => count($auction['bids'])];
        } finally {
            $this->releaseLock($lock);
        }
    }

    public function getBidCount(string $auctionId): array {
        $auction = $this->loadAuction($auctionId);
        if ($auction === null) {
            return ['error' => 'Auction not found'];
        }
        return ['bid_count' => count($auction['bids'])];
    }

    public function revealBids(string $auctionId, string $requesterId): array {
        $lock = $this->acquireLock($auctionId);
        try {
            $auction = $this->loadAuction($auctionId);
            if ($auction === null) {
                return ['error' => 'Auction not found'];
            }
            if (time() <= $auction['deadline']) {
                return ['error' => 'Bidding period not yet closed'];
            }
            // Return commits for verification phase
            $commits = [];
            foreach ($auction['bids'] as $bidder => $bid) {
                $commits[$bidder] = $bid['commit'];
            }
            $auction['revealed'] = true;
            $this->saveAuction($auctionId, $auction);
            return ['success' => true, 'commits' => $commits];
        } finally {
            $this->releaseLock($lock);
        }
    }

    public function verifyAndFinalize(string $auctionId, array $reveals): array {
        $lock = $this->acquireLock($auctionId);
        try {
            $auction = $this->loadAuction($auctionId);
            if ($auction === null) {
                return ['error' => 'Auction not found'];
            }
            if (!$auction['revealed']) {
                return ['error' => 'Bids not yet revealed'];
            }
            $validBids = [];
            foreach ($reveals as $bidderId => $reveal) {
                if (!isset($auction['bids'][$bidderId])) continue;
                $expectedCommit = $auction['bids'][$bidderId]['commit'];
                // Verify: H(amount || nonce) == commit
                $checkHash = hash('sha256', $reveal['amount'] . $reveal['nonce']);
                if (hash_equals($expectedCommit, $checkHash)) {
                    $validBids[$bidderId] = (int)$reveal['amount'];
                }
            }
            if (empty($validBids)) {
                return ['error' => 'No valid bids'];
            }
            arsort($validBids);
            $winner = array_key_first($validBids);
            return ['success' => true, 'winner' => $winner, 'amount' => $validBids[$winner]];
        } finally {
            $this->releaseLock($lock);
        }
    }
}

// HTTP Router
$keyFile = __DIR__ . '/auction.key';
if (!file_exists($keyFile)) {
    $key = Key::createNewRandomKey();
    file_put_contents($keyFile, $key->saveToAsciiSafeString());
} else {
    $key = Key::loadFromAsciiSafeString(file_get_contents($keyFile));
}

$server = new AuctionServer(__DIR__ . '/data', $key);
$method = $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'];
$path = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'], PHP_URL_PATH);
$input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true) ?? [];

header('Content-Type: application/json');

// Timing normalization - prevent timing side channels
$startTime = hrtime(true);
$minResponseTime = 50_000_000; // 50ms minimum

switch (true) {
    case $method === 'POST' && preg_match('#^/auction/create$#', $path):
        $result = $server->createAuction(
            $input['auction_id'] ?? '',
            $input['item'] ?? '',
            $input['deadline'] ?? 0
        );
        break;
    case $method === 'POST' && preg_match('#^/auction/([\w-]+)/bid$#', $path, $m):
        $result = $server->submitBid(
            $m[1],
            $input['bidder_id'] ?? '',
            $input['commit'] ?? ''
        );
        break;
    case $method === 'GET' && preg_match('#^/auction/([\w-]+)/status$#', $path, $m):
        $result = $server->getBidCount($m[1]);
        break;
    case $method === 'POST' && preg_match('#^/auction/([\w-]+)/reveal$#', $path, $m):
        $result = $server->revealBids($m[1], $input['requester_id'] ?? '');
        break;
    case $method === 'POST' && preg_match('#^/auction/([\w-]+)/finalize$#', $path, $m):
        $result = $server->verifyAndFinalize($m[1], $input['reveals'] ?? []);
        break;
    default:
        http_response_code(404);
        $result = ['error' => 'Not found'];
}

// Enforce minimum response time
$elapsed = hrtime(true) - $startTime;
if ($elapsed < $minResponseTime) {
    time_nanosleep(0, $minResponseTime - $elapsed);
}

echo json_encode($result);
